name: apple-suite-mcp
description: Secure, modular, opt-in MCP connector for the Apple app suite (Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Notes, Mail, Messages, Maps, Photos, Music).
author: Hanlun Wang

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:native

//: Deps pinned to exact versions (no ^/~, no @latest) per DESIGN.md §5.2. Update deliberately, verify provenance.
better-sqlite3 will be added in M4 (messages module) — not before it is needed.
Tests use the Node built-in test runner (node:test) — zero extra dev dependencies. Running TS directly needs Node >= 22.6 (CI uses 24); the published dist runs on >= 20.
